extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: single-engine high-wing floatplane (seaplane), approx. 10.1 x 15.2 x 4.8 m (L incl. propeller x wingspan x H), float length 7.7 m
extras.notes: nose faces -Y; stands on the keels of its two floats (z = 0), add your own water (float waterline at 0.22 m: blue stripe above the antifouling); separate moving parts with origin on their axis: seaplane_propeller (spins around the engine axis), seaplane_water_rudder_l/_r (turn around Z); opaque tinted windows, no interior; no text, no registration, no brand

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
